cardOverview.overviewText: The Bank of Baroda (BOB) Cashback Credit Card offers up to 5% cashback on online spends in select categories, 1% on all other purchases, and automatic statement credits, with a ₹499 annual fee and additional benefits like fuel surcharge waivers and no limits on base cashback.
